title: Ugh, Canada
summary: Some of you hopefully noticed that I didn’t publish anything last week. That was intentional – I was on a long-planned vacation to the Canadian Maritimes (Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island), hoping to see the Bay of Fundy tides and to unplug in a combination of small cities, unspoiled beaches, and sparsely populated towns. I happily checked all those boxes except one – I could not escape the news about the US-Canada trade negotiations. After spending the bulk of my professional life trading in the Canadian markets, I was unable to avoid pondering the ramifications of their breakdown.
